Food safety officials uncover expired goods relabeling racket

Authorities in Maharashtra and Bengaluru have uncovered separate rackets involving the relabeling and resale of expired food products. In Maharashtra's Thane district, the FDA busted a operation where expired goods were being repackaged. In Bengaluru, a special drive inspected warehouses fulfilling online grocery orders, finding expired items valued at over ₹2.35 lakh.
